column1: Allows caster to go without food or water and not suffer damage (i.e., provides nutrition and water for 1 day).
column2: Caster can produce sufficient in any available receptacle to supply a being for one day.
column3: Caster can produce sufficient food from the surrounding area to feed 1 hearty appetite for 1 day.
column4: Allows caster to set a fire of 1'R; fire will then last as long as there is fuel. A target in the 1'R will take an 'A' Heat critical.
column5: Caster can produce 1 loaf of waybread that weighs .5lb and will support 1 being for 1 day; the loaf will lose potency in 1 month.
column6: As Water Production I, except caster can produce 3 days of water.
column7: As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed 3 beings for 1 day.
column8: Allows caster to enhance the potency of any 1 growing herb by 100\% (i.e., x2); spell may be employed only once per herb.
column9: As Water Production I, except caster can produce 5 days of water.
column10: As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed 5 beings for 1 day.
column11: As Nutrient Conjure I, except caster can produce 3 loaves of waybread.
column12: Caster can double the potency of any 1 herb (growing or dead); spell may be employed only once/herb. May not be combined with Herb Enhancement.
column13: Caster can produce a plant up to 10' in height and/or width; plant must be commonly found in the region.
column14: As Water Production I, except caster can create 1 day of water per level (e.g., a 17th level Cleric could create 17 days of water).
column15: As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed a number of beings equal to his level.
column16: Caster can create an animal representative of the surrounding region and weighing no more than 10 pounds; animal will be friendly to caster.
column17: As Nutrient Conjure I, except caster can produce loaves of waybread equal to his level.
column18: As Lesser Plant Production, except that caster can create 1 plant with a height and/or width of 1' per level (e.g., a 30th level could produce a 20' high tree with a 30' maximum width); plant must be commonly found in the local area.
column19: As Lesser Animal Production, except that caster can produce an animal with a maximum weight of 1 pound per level; the animal must be a native of the area.
